# Camp Resource: Raider Mirelurk Boil

__Raider Mirelurk Boil__

*"Make sure to get a good dinner in before you go off raiding."*

__Overview__

A decorative CAMP resource that passively produces Mirelurk-based food buffs. Does not require power and can be locked.

## **__Function__**

__Function__

| **Item Produced** | **Buff Type** | **Base Effect** | **Carnivore** | **Carnivore + SIN** | **Drop Rate** |
| Roasted Mirelurk Meat | Max AP | +10 Max AP | +20 Max AP | +25 Max AP | 25% |
| Cooked Softshell Meat | Max AP | +20 Max AP | +40 Max AP | +50 Max AP | 25% |
| Mirelurk Jerky | Damage Resistance | +15 DR | +30 DR | +38 DR | 25% |
| Smoked Mirelurk Fillets | Carry Weight | +30 lbs | +60 lbs | +75 lbs | 25% |

- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: Mirelurk Steamer
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 2

__Crafting Requirements__

- 3x Steel
- 2x Wood

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 10 pounds of Mirelurk food items

__How to Unlock__

- Atom Shop:
 - Raider Mirelurk Boil: X Atoms
 - X Bundle: X Atoms (includes Raider Mirelurk Boil)
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
